title: Lighting
summary: Two lights: a warm point light (3200 K) at the back for a soft rim, and a spot light high near the camera aimed at the donuts, with a soft cone.
expected_result: A dark scene with a pool of warm light on the plate and donuts, and a warm glow from behind.

steps.note: a point light at the back, higher, bigger radius (soft shadows), warm 3200 K, power lowered: only a detail
the main light: a spot near the camera but very high, aimed at the donuts, a soft-edged cone, a bit warm
the default dark world: the spot does the lighting
